name: ramp-switchback
description: #1939: a two-leg ramp (switchback) ordered from the console, dug leg by leg into the pit, then a debris_hauler drives down it over the corner landing and back up.

expect.note: Staffed site: drill_rig #1, debris_hauler #2, rock_digger #3, drivers #4/#5 with excavator licence.

steps.description: Crew the rock_digger #3 with excavator driver #4 so the ordered ramp is actually dug.

#1939: a two-leg switchback: 12m south from (15,15), then 10m east to (25,27) -- 22m total, 6m deep, default grade atan(6/22). The Build panel has no multi-leg path tool yet, so the order is a console command (exact-command allowlist entry in bootstrap-allowlist.ts).

expect.note: 22m x 3 wide x RAMP_COST_PER_METER_PER_WIDTH (100/3) = 2200; the corner is counted once.

steps.description: Drain every queued dig_ramp_segment layer, leg by leg, until both legs and the corner landing are carved.
Send the debris_hauler (#2) to the far end of the second leg: its route runs down leg one, over the corner landing and along leg two. reposition drafts an idle licensed driver.
The hauler's drive down the ramp completed (pendingActionCount back to 0) -- it routed over the corner.

expect.note: Hauler reached the bottom of the switchback.

steps.description: Drive the hauler back up to the surface above the ramp head.
The hauler's climb back up the ramp completed.

expect.note: Hauler climbed the switchback back to the surface; stuckEmployeeCount stays 0.
